drops.headline: Dawn edition (sample): the spectrum, before the building wakes up
drops.summary: A fictional morning brief used to prove the content-store contract. Nothing here is a report, a tasking order, or a sensor product.

items.title: Illustrative figures stay labeled
items.dek: Example item. Latency, library size, and accuracy are illustrative targets, not measured results. This server repeats that label on every figure.

items.title: The only optional caller input is a ZIP
items.dek: Example item. get_news_drop accepts a time slot and, if offered, a 5-digit ZIP. v0.1 does not log or store it.

items.title: Research division remains closed
items.dek: Example item. Advanced research is not open for briefing. This drop does not speculate about it.
